name: Mahdi Translator Pro 4.1.1 — RTranslator-grade on-device AI
description: Advanced on-device neural translator (NLLB / Marian-Bergamot / Whisper via Transformers.js + ONNX Runtime Web), WalkieTalkie dual-language mode, WebRTC peer-to-peer translated conversation, document/subtitle translation, offline phrasebook with Leitner flashcards, 1544 themes and cloud sync. v4.1 adds a Google gtx keyless engine, mixed-script output guard with name transliteration in both online and offline modes, word-by-word breakdown analysis, wake lock, phrase of the day and a fully Android-responsive interface.
